answer: We formalize Sybil resistance via a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function integrated with a glacier of frozen staking collateral. In this game, adversaries attempting identity multiplication face a subgame-perfect slashing matrix that flattens any potential payoff into a negative mesa. This mathematical bound reduces the viability of multi-agent attacks to a mere fable, proving that the unique Nash equilibrium forces rational actors to maintain a single honest identity to avoid guaranteed capital loss.
